$comment: Edit the numbers below to retune the OEM image-fit verdict; restart the .exe to pick up the changes.
Set 'defaultProfile' to choose which tier runs when no --profile is passed on the command line.
Per-item budgets gate row coloring (red over-budget / yellow near-budget / green under-budget); total budgets gate the per-category PASS / WATCH / FAIL banner.
All MB values are MiB (1 MiB = 1,048,576 bytes).
To restore this file to defaults after editing, delete it and re-run MemoryUsageChecker.exe (the tool will seed a fresh copy) or run: MemoryUsageChecker.exe --write-default-profiles

verdictThresholds.$comment: Percent of the budget at which a row turns yellow (warnAtPercent) or red (failAtPercent). Strictly: actual > failAt = Fail; actual >= warnAt = Warn; else Pass.

16gb.$comment: Relaxed tier for higher-end OEM devices with 16 GB total RAM. Use as a soft ceiling so the preload does not bloat over time.

8gb.$comment: Default tier. Calibrated against a real Windows 11 24H2 OEM-like trace so the worst contributor in each category turns red.

4gb.$comment: Tightest tier. Targets 4 GB-class devices; per-item and total budgets are roughly halved vs the 8 GB tier.
